title: Repository bug repair

upstream.role: requirement source; no upstream code copied

notes: Lite fix included: verify_score.py treats a non-object `dimensions` as a fatal-zero contract error.
Verifier and Result-judge jobs bind-mount the host git (and strace); move into the image later.
Smoke verified 2026-10-01 on a clean clone: doctor/setup/run, held-out test_001 = 73 (valid).

Release change (2026-10-10): adapter/eval-template/solution/run_eval.py normalize_evaluation_state reads the judge's prose (assessment, major_errors) as an infrastructure marker only when it holds the standalone token INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR or INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID (underscores, any case, no letter, digit or underscore immediately before or after). The previous rule turned every non-alphanumeric into '_' and matched substrings, so prose such as 'evaluator-side infrastructure errors' voided a scored case. The harness, the transport and the judge's structured evaluation_state mark infrastructure as before, and verify_score.py reads the state run_eval writes.

Release change (2026-10-10): benchmark/evaluator/harness/evaluate_case.py removes its per-case scratch tree through evaluation_directory, whose cleanup never raises. Submitted code (public tests, hidden checks, the recovery self-test) runs there as uid 65534 and may create directories under {work}, HOME or TMPDIR; the verifier runs without CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE and CAP_FOWNER, so it can neither empty nor chmod them. tempfile.TemporaryDirectory's cleanup then raised PermissionError even with ignore_cleanup_errors=True, and the harness exited before writing harness_result.json, so the case ended as an infrastructure error with no result. The harness now writes the same result it computed, reports an incomplete cleanup as one JSON line on stderr (harness.stdout.log), and leaves the remainder to the disposable verifier container. Checks, scores and the result file are unchanged.

Release change (2026-10-10): adapter/eval-template/solution/run_eval.py retries a Result-judge request once with reduced evidence when it does not fit the judge context. The trigger is an HTTP 400 whose body says the context length was exceeded, or an HTTP 400 with no provider message while the prompt's upper token estimate is above 900,000 (the 1,048,576-token context minus the 100,000-token output limit, less 5%). The first request is unchanged. The reduced prompt is built in steps, re-estimated after each, and the eval stops once it fits: repeated harness values become references, then binary files, then files that are neither required deliverables nor listed in run_report.json artifact_paths, become path/size/sha256 markers. A prompt that still does not fit, or a failed retry, stays an infrastructure error. eval_result.json records evidence_reduced, a non-scoring prompt_reduction receipt (also prompt_reduction.json) and redacted samples of every judge 4xx body (judge_http_errors). verify_score.py is unchanged.
